summary: Rootcause7 upstream repair after Main rework1 false green. KnowledgeDispositionReviewV1 and the current host boundary can be satisfied by a model that only echoes hashes: the receipt/prompt does not carry the frozen semantic evidence, Admission comparison semantics, calibrated rubric/axes, or an independently verifiable actual evaluator execution identity; Main can stamp authorized provider/model/load/run fields after a generic AgentService call. Extend the existing Core strict production authority with a typed semantic disposition-review execution/result contract that conserves the actual evaluator host invocation and decision into review authority, explicitly separates strict workflow run identity from evaluator invocation run identity, and binds the complete reviewable semantics for producer merge/duplicate/non-draft and investigated-empty. Fail closed on self-attestation, missing semantic inputs, identity/load/run/output mismatch, stale/rebound/reused authority and opaque hash-only pass. Preserve all accepted rootcause6 fact/fixpoint/execution/finalization work; Core-only, no LLM implementation, no Main/Agent edits, no Test.
sourceRef: Original Plan completion bullets 8-9 and Requirement Design §§11.6, 12.2, 18.1, 18.3, 18.6; controller rejection evt-20260727140454-0238; Alembic commit 1c162697 and reviewer-invocations/checkpoint evidence
designIntent: 在 AlembicCore 现有 strict production authority 内补齐可被 Agent 真实执行、被 Main 机械验证的 semantic disposition-review execution contract：Core 只定义不可伪造/不可重绑的 typed authority 与 fail-closed 规则，不实现 LLM reviewer、不引入第二平台。

required.verify: One clean AlembicCore commit based exactly on 96655b9bbd56f22381ffa7f48a6cd52cabc5a1da; report parent, commit, tree and changed files; Alembic and AlembicAgent source remain untouched.
Run AlembicCore build/check, focused strict production/knowledge disposition tests, full repository tests, and git diff --check.

A typed Core semantic disposition-review execution/result authority must bind the common strict workflow run separately from the actual evaluator host invocation run/id, exact provider/model/method/version, prompt hash, reviewer model/config load receipt, response-output hash, calibration, and typed verdict/reason/evidence. Producer merge/duplicate/non-draft also binds exact AdmissionReceipt/fingerprint/target plus full fixpoint/population/hypothesis/falsification context; investigated-empty binds the sealed schedule, full terminal denominator and negative-evidence sufficiency context. The contract must have an explicit named Agent producer and Main consumer route, not an unused type.

Reject identity stamped after an unrelated call, missing/malformed semantic evidence, hash-only echo pass, missing calibration/load evidence, provider/model/run/invocation/output mismatch, producer-reviewer self invocation, stale/rebound Admission/fixpoint/population/schedule/target, reused execution/result, non-pass, and output/decision hash mismatch.

AlembicCore only. No Agent/Main/Plugin/Dashboard/Design/Test/Wakeflow/vendor/cache edits, no LLM/provider implementation, no second reviewer service, and no weakening of already accepted fact/fixpoint/execution/finalization/CAS contracts.

Explain why V1 plus Main's current hash-echo helper could pass without semantic review and how the new contract prevents that exact false green without conflating workflow runId with host invocation run identity.

targetTasks.summary: Define and prove the Core semantic disposition-review execution authority required for an Agent-owned real evaluator and a Main mechanical consumer, eliminating the hash-echo/stamped-identity false green.
